WARNING: THIS IS A LIVE BLOG. Yesterday the Guardian and Independent live blogs both wrongly reported the Drumcree march as under way. Treat everything here as provisional. The poll figures below are quoted by the blog from More in Common and have NOT been independently confirmed against a settled news article or More in Common's own release.

"On Thursday two MRP polls showed that, with Burnham as Labour leader, Reform UK has suffered a huge setback. More in Common has another out this morning. 'More in Common's latest MRP projects Labour on 250 seats and Reform on 147, a sharp reversal from July's projection of Reform 293 and Labour 110,' it says."
